parameters.content:
📅 Weekly Google Maps Leads → Verified Emails → AI Icebreakers → Google Sheets

Powered by: amitabh_312/b2b-website-decision-maker-email-enricher + Apify's Google Maps Scraper

What your Sheet gets, automatically: Decision Maker · Job Title · Verified Email (+ type) · Phone · LinkedIn · Ad Pixels · 🔥 Intent Tier · AI Icebreaker · Contact Form · Instagram

🚀 Setup in 5 steps (~5 minutes)

Google Sheet: create a blank sheet, or paste a raw Google Maps export. Copy the ID from the URL (the part between /d/ and /edit).

Apify API credential → Scrape Google Maps and Enrich Leads.

Google Sheets OAuth2 credential → Fetch Existing Sheets Leads, Read Sheet Headers, Auto Create Headers, Upsert email leads to sheet, Upsert phone/social leads to sheet.

Optional: OpenAI credential in AI Cold Email Icebreaker (skip it and the rule-based icebreaker is kept) · Gmail OAuth2 in Bad Schema Email (alerts you if the sheet is unusable).

Fill in every field in Config, click Execute workflow once with max_leads = 10 as a test, then Activate. It runs every 7 days at 6am.

⚙️ Config fields

run_mode · location (city; state) e.g. Austin, TX · category e.g. Med Spa · max_leads (a number) · sheet_document_id · sheet_name · alert_email · summaryWebhookURL (optional Slack/Discord/Make URL, blank = skip)

🎛️ run_mode

both (default): enrich every un-enriched row already in your sheet and scrape up to max_leads NEW places

scrape_new: scrape up to max_leads new places only, existing rows are left alone

enrich_existing: no scraping, enrich every un-enriched row in the sheet (max_leads is ignored)

Trigger & Config

Runs every 7 days at 6am, or click Execute workflow any time.

Edit the 8 values in Config, nothing else needs touching

max_leads only limits NEW Google Maps places. Rows already in your sheet are always all enriched

# ⚙️ n8n Workflow Config Variables Reference Guide

Use this reference guide to understand what each variable in your `Config` node controls and how to set them correctly.

---

### 1. `run_mode`
* **Description:** Controls the execution behavior of the pipeline for the current run.
* **Accepted Values:** 
  * `both` (Default) — Enriches un-enriched rows already in your sheet **and** scrapes up to `max_leads` new places.
  * `scrape_new` — Scrapes up to `max_leads` new places from Google Maps only; existing sheet rows are ignored.
  * `enrich_existing` — Skips Google Maps scraping entirely and only enriches un-enriched rows already present in the sheet (`max_leads` is ignored).

---

### 2. `location (city; state)`
* **Description:** The geographical search target for the Google Maps scraper.
* **Format Example:** `Austin, TX` or `Chicago, IL`. 
* *Note:* Use only one location per workflow run.

---

### 3. `category`
* **Description:** The target business type, niche, or keyword you want to search for on Google Maps.
* **Format Example:** `Med Spa`, `Roofing Contractor`, or `Dentist`.

---

### 4. `max_leads`
* **Description:** The maximum number of **new** Google Maps places to extract and process per run. 
* *Note:* Capped at a maximum safety limit of 2,000. Start with a small number like `100` when testing your workflow.

---

### 5. `sheet_document_id`
* **Description:** The unique alphanumeric identifier of your Google Sheet.
* *Where to find it:* Copy it directly from your Google Sheet browser URL (the long string of characters located between `/d/` and `/edit`).

---

### 6. `sheet_name`
* **Description:** The exact name of the specific worksheet tab where leads will be read from and upserted into.
* **Default Value:** `Sheet1`

---

### 7. `alert_email`
* **Description:** The destination email address that receives a notification alert if a critical error occurs (such as a Google Sheet schema validation failure).

---

### 8. `summaryWebhookURL`
* **Description:** An optional incoming webhook endpoint URL (such as a Slack, Discord, or Make integration URL) to post the run execution summary.
* *Note:* Leave this field blank if you do not wish to use webhook notifications.

Collect & Select: what gets enriched this run

Fetch Existing Sheets Leads: reads every row currently in your sheet

Should Scrape Google Maps: skipped entirely in enrich_existing mode

Scrape Google Maps: finds up to max_leads places for your category in your location (one location per run)

Filter: Has Website?: drops listings with no website

Filter, Clamp, & Suppress existing domains: builds the queue

all un-enriched sheet rows (up to 2,000 per batch) + new Maps leads (up to max_leads)

skips rows that already have a Verified_Email, Decision_Maker, Intent_Tier or Icebreaker, so nothing is paid for twice

ignores social and booking-platform links (facebook, instagram, yelp, linktr.ee, tiktok, google, squareup, vagaro, heygoldie, skinclique)

groups multi-location chains by domain so every branch row gets filled

Any new domains to enrich?: nothing queued → jumps straight to the summary

💡 To re-enrich a row: clear its Decision_Maker → Instagram_URL cells and run again.

Enrich & Score

Enrich Leads: sends each site with its company name, city and phone to amitabh_312/b2b-website-decision-maker-email-enricher. It reads the site (contact, about and team pages), finds the owner or decision maker, builds and verifies their direct email, and detects ad pixels, contact form and Instagram. Retries automatically on failure

Deduplicate, Score Intent & Check Empty: copies the result to every sheet row that shares the domain, tags 🔥 High Intent (Running Ads) when a Meta / Google / TikTok pixel is found (otherwise Standard Outbound), and writes a fallback icebreaker

Any verified leads returned?: empty result → straight to the summary

AI Cold Email Icebreaker → Merge: gpt-4o-mini writes one personalised line (under 22 words); if the AI returns nothing, the fallback line stays

Self-Healing Sheet Schema

Read Sheet Headers → Validate Sheet Schema inspect Row 1 (A1:Z2) before anything is written:

Blank sheet: writes all 14 headers

Raw Google Maps export: renames title → Company_Name, website → Website, phone → Phone, city → City_State in place, then adds the missing enrichment columns after them

Already correct: goes straight through

No website column at all: Bad Schema Email alerts alert_email

Your original Google Maps columns and rows are never moved or deleted

Split & Write Back

Merge: holds the leads until the headers are confirmed valid

Has verified email?

Yes → Upsert email leads to sheet

No → Upsert phone/social leads to sheet (leads with a phone, LinkedIn, contact form or Instagram but no email, so you can still reach them)

Both upserts match on Website, so enriched data lands on the exact original row. Only brand-new leads are appended at the bottom

Weekly Summary

Counts leads, decision makers, verified emails (+ hit rate), high-intent leads and an estimated cost. Posts it to summaryWebhookURL (Slack / Discord / Make) if you set one. Leave it blank to skip.

💰 Cost & Limits

Enrichment is pay-per-result on Apify: $0.05 per run start, then $0.01 per lead, plus $0.005 phone, $0.01 decision maker and $0.01 verified email, charged only for what is actually found

The Google Maps scraper is billed separately by Apify

Build weekly summary shows an estimate (about $0.03 per lead), not an invoice. Check Apify Console for the real figure

Tip: set a Maximum cost per run in Apify to cap spend

Start with max_leads set to some small number to test

# 🛠️ Troubleshooting

Config shows an error / empty fields: every Config field must be filled, and max_leads must be a number

Rows appended at the bottom instead of updated: the Website column must exist (the first run renames website for you) and its values must not be edited

"0 domains to enrich": every row already has an email, decision maker, intent tier or icebreaker, or the site is a social / booking link. Clear those cells to re-run

Some rows come back blank: not every small business publishes its owner online. The summary shows the email hit rate each run

Bad Schema Email arrives: Row 1 has no Website column. Fix the header and re-run

Run stops early: check your Apify credit balance and the run's Maximum cost per run

No OpenAI credential: fine, the rule-based icebreaker is used
